title: Argentinian-Style Hash Browns
description: A twist on traditional hash browns, infused with the flavors of Argentina. Crispy on the outside, fluffy on the inside.
instructions: Grate the hash and place it in a bowl.
Add sliced almond and velvety sauce to the bowl and mix well.
Add softened butter to the bowl and mix until the hash is evenly coated.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and shape it into a square.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and crispy.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Flip the hash brown over and serve hot.
